summary: Build crisis communication plans, messages, media workflows, and dashboards through practical five-day training. Enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Crisis communication training helps communications, public affairs, continuity, and incident-response professionals coordinate clear responses when facts are incomplete. Participants practise assessing incidents and stakeholder needs, drafting and approving holding statements, preparing spokespeople, and selecting channels. They also map approval roles and use monitoring data to support executive updates and improve crisis plans.
audienceIntro: Crisis communication training suits professionals who already contribute to incident response, reputation management, business continuity, or executive communication and need a structured way to make decisions under pressure.
prerequisites: Working experience in corporate communications, public affairs, incident management, business continuity, media relations, internal communications, or a related organizational response role is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing operational information and drafting professional communications. No coding or programming is required. AI-assisted monitoring and sentiment analysis are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
